pr_body:
Adds options to QSTR function.

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/118619 added named function parameters. This PR uses this mechanism for allowing query string function parameters, so [query string parameters](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/query-dsl-query-string-query.html#query-string-top-level-params) can be used in ES|QL.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/120933
pr_title: Added optional parameters to QSTR ES|QL function

review_comment: We can probably extract this testing code to a separate method so both `match` and `qstr` can reuse it
This is essentially the same as the Match options one, not sure if it is worth refactoring....

Yes, I think it would be good to have common code for `match` and `qstr` options.

We can include it in `FullTextFunctions`, or have a separate utility class.

I looked into this, but it does not produce a good interface. There are a lot of options needed to be passed to this utility class which IMO defeats the purpose. Lets keep separate, which would allow both to evolve and be fixed independently if needed. Same for the testing change below.
That's ok, we can do that as a follow up PR if needed be.
It would be a good idea to add the default values for each field, so users understand what is expected if they don't provide it. This is something we need to do in MATCH.
I was wondering about how to do that. Are there are examples you can point me to?

I mean adding the default values in the `description`, so we would have something like:

```
name = "analyze_wildcard",
                    type = "keyword",
                    valueHint = { "false" },
                    description = "If true, the query attempts to analyze wildcard terms in the query string. Defaults to false."
```

The "defaults to false" bit is what we can add to the options description so users are aware of the default values, and don't have to go looking at the query string docs for it.
I see... I have defaults for some descriptions but not others. Will make another pass.
